privacy.title: Your data and your account
privacy.sign_in: Sign in to manage your data.
privacy.intro: You can get a copy of your data, or close your account.
export.title: A copy of your data
export.intro: We prepare a file with your account, orders, listings, messages and ratings. You can ask once every 7 days; the file is kept for 7 days.
export.preparing: Your copy is being prepared (asked on {at}). We will tell you when it is ready.
export.ready: Your copy is ready. The download link works until {until}.
export.expired: Your last copy has been deleted.
export.in_progress: A copy is already being prepared.
export.once_a_week: You can ask for a copy once every 7 days.
export.once_a_week_until: You can ask for a copy once every 7 days. You can ask again from {at}.
close.title: Close your account
close.intro: Closing your account cannot be undone. When you close it:
close.effect.erasure: your personal data is deleted or anonymised within 30 days;
close.effect.records: records the law requires, such as settlements, are kept for their retention period.
close.confirm: Your account will be closed now and you will be signed out. This cannot be undone.
close.refused: Your account cannot be closed yet:
close.reason.auction-with-bids: one of your auctions has bids;
close.reason.offer-open: a second-chance offer to you is open;
close.reason.payout-pending: a payout is still on its way;
close.reason.refund-pending: a refund to you is still on its way;
close.reason.kyc-under-review: your identity check is under review;
close.done: Your account is closed and you are signed out. Your personal data will be deleted or anonymised within 30 days.
